'''Bora Edtuth''' was a naïve [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] seen in the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Attractive for a Gungan, she enjoyed dancing and watching the effect her movements caused in others, even if she could not completely understand why.
